pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions on the neck and shoulder area transitioning into smaller, more densely packed irregular shapes on the flank. Edge angularity is high but characterized by soft pixel gradients due to image resolution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a reticulated web. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, appearing wider in the neck region and narrowing significantly towards the hindquarters.
